title: Resolve total market-cap missing-vs-derivable semantics with source-compatible provenance
objective: Resolve the framework's total-market-cap / TOTAL / TOTAL2 missing-versus-derivable semantics without creating false precision. Determine the current consumer/inventory path that labels total market cap unavailable, identify whether an already-collected same-source global market-cap value can be reused and durably exposed, and implement the smallest provenance-safe repair. A CoinGecko BTC market cap divided by CoinMarketCap BTC dominance must never be promoted as canonical TOTAL because the numerator and denominator use different providers/universes. Cross-source calculations, if retained at all, must be explicitly non-binding proxy estimates. Prefer reuse/persistence of an existing same-source global source over a new sensor or hybrid derivation.
primary_target: existing total-market-cap inventory/consumer and nearest existing global-market owner/interface
allowed_change_scope: scripts/daily_capture/directly related global market or market-context owner/interface
scripts/data_terminal/directly related existing global market collector/normalizer
02_DATA_PING/directly related owner/interface or bridge contract if existing
03_DAILY_CAPTURE_LOGS/directly related compact global-market owner path if existing architecture calls for persistence
tests/directly related market-cap provenance and derivability tests

evidence.summary: The breadth owner is explicitly sourced from COINGECKO_MARKET_CAP; its Bitcoin constituent market_cap_usd is therefore a CoinGecko value.

The BTC.D owner uses CMC_DIRECT_SOURCE_CONVENTION: CoinMarketCap BTC market cap divided by the total market cap of cryptoassets tracked by CoinMarketCap. It explicitly does not represent a different provider/universe convention.

The documented permanent daily-capture lanes do not currently name a global total-market-cap owner, so a consumer may legitimately surface the field as unavailable unless another existing owner/interface is reused.

Challenger flagged total market cap as derivable via BTC_mcap / BTC.D. Audit confirms arithmetic derivability but finds provider/universe mismatch between CoinGecko market cap and CMC dominance, so the hybrid result is not canonical without explicit proxy semantics.

reproduction: On fresh main, locate the exact inventory/consumer that marks total market cap/TOTAL/TOTAL2 unavailable. Trace every proposed input to provider, source timestamp, denominator universe and owner semantics. Demonstrate that CoinGecko BTC market cap divided by CMC_DIRECT_SOURCE_CONVENTION BTC.D is a cross-source hybrid and cannot reproduce a provider-native total by contract. Search for an already-collected same-source global market-cap payload/owner (including existing DATA PING/global market collection paths) before adding any persistence. If an existing same-source value can be reused, bind and expose it with exact timestamps/provenance. If no compatible same-source value exists, preserve UNKNOWN/MISSING or explicitly non-binding CROSS_SOURCE_PROXY rather than inventing canonical TOTAL.

positive: The affected inventory/consumer distinguishes DIRECT_OWNER, SAME_SOURCE_DERIVED, CROSS_SOURCE_PROXY and UNAVAILABLE/UNKNOWN rather than treating all arithmetic derivations as equivalent.

Any canonical/owner-grade total market-cap value is built from a provider-native global total or a mathematically equivalent same-provider numerator/denominator with timestamp and universe compatibility proven in the artifact.

If an existing global-market source is already collected elsewhere, the implementation reuses it rather than creating a duplicate sensor, and persists/exposes only the smallest owner/interface needed by current consumers.
TOTAL2 or analogous derived values inherit the provenance/quality class of their inputs and fail closed when subtraction inputs are incompatible or stale.
Fixtures cover same-source derivation, cross-source mismatch, timestamp mismatch, missing value and no-silent-fallback behavior.
negative: Do not label CoinGecko BTC market cap divided by CoinMarketCap BTC.D as canonical TOTAL or owner-grade total market cap.
Do not create a second global-market sensor if an existing source/collector already provides the needed value.
Do not convert missing data to zero, silently substitute current values for point-in-time values, or relax provenance/freshness checks merely to eliminate DATA_MISSING.
Do not change market gates, model weights, portfolio actions or July 12 breadth/BTC.D zero-weight semantics.

forbidden_changes: historical pseudo-values or backfill without point-in-time lineage
